oracle.note: Official HF rust tokenizers binding loading nomic's committed tokenizer.json (BertNormalizer + BertPreTokenizer + WordPiece + [CLS]/[SEP]).

prefix_convention.source: flair resources/embeddings-provider.ts + harper-fabric-embeddings src/engine.ts NOMIC_TEMPLATES; replicated in harness/lib/prefix.js

observed.nfc_nfd_note: BERT strip_accents (NFD + drop Mn) collapses unicode-nfc and unicode-nfd to the same token IDs. The corpus trap prose anticipated they would not collide; the pinned HF nomic tokenizer does. Goldens record the reference, not the trap guess.

llamacpp_crosscheck.method: llama-embedding --verbose-prompt on the same prefixed corpus bytes

unicode-nfd.note: Real tokenizer difference. llama.cpp WPM leaves combining marks; WordPiece then emits [UNK]. HF BertNormalizer strip_accents drops Mn, so NFD becomes cafe/resume/naive like NFC. This slice pins the official nomic HF tokenizer.json. Issue #5 (forward vs llama.cpp vectors) must treat unicode-nfd as a known HF↔llama.cpp tokenizer split.

whitespace-only.note: llama-embedding -f splits the prompt on the embedded newline, so --verbose-prompt prints two sequences (extra CLS/SEP). Not a WordPiece ID disagreement on the concatenated string.

newlines-tabs.note: Same llama-embedding newline-as-prompt-separator artifact (CLS/SEP inserted at CR/LF). Not a WordPiece ID disagreement.
